evals.name: defers-to-github-pr-merge
evals.prompt: Open a PR from feat/checkout into main and merge it. No review needed, I already looked at it.

evals.name: fires-github-pr-workflow-only
evals.prompt: Open a PR from feat/checkout into main, have an agent review it once, and merge only if it passes. If it fails just leave the comment and stop — don't try to fix anything.

evals.name: defers-to-github-pr-workflow
evals.prompt: Create a PR from feat/checkout into main and get it merged. Have a reviewer agent go over it, and if it comes back failed, fix the issues and re-review until it's clean.
